args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt/shipment recording), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents, VendorMaterialProcurementCoordinator agent (AGENT ONLY)
- sap.ehs: Safety/health agents
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (READ/monitor vendor + PO data)
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (NO create API)
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionChangeOrchestrator, BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator
- siemens.plm: PLM - EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, BOMComplianceValidator
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

WAREHOUSE RECEIPT MANAGEMENT:
sap.s4:apiResource:MaterialReceiptInboundAPI:v1 - BEST FOR RECORDING INCOMING SHIPMENTS:
  • REST API for creating and managing goods receipt transactions
  • Links received materials to purchase orders
  • Processes supplier shipments at warehouse intake
  • Maintains incoming inventory records

ORGANIZATIONAL HIERARCHY / REPORTING STRUCTURE:
- No dedicated API found in landscape for querying organizational hierarchy or reporting relationships
- workday.hcm & sap.sf have agents that work WITH org hierarchy internally (PerformanceReviewCoordinator agents) but don't expose it
- sap.sf PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator creates assignments "based on organizational hierarchy" but this is agent-driven automation, not a data query API
- No REST API available to READ reporting structure or pull org breakdown data

WORKFORCE SKILLS & ENGINEERING REQUIREMENTS:
sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - BEST FOR WORKFORCE SKILLS & PRODUCT TRANSITION:
  • Monitors employee competencies and engineering change requests
  • Coordinates optimal resource allocation for product transition
  • Evaluates capability gaps and recommends development/reassignment actions
  • Processes material & product item requirements across projects
  • Dynamic workforce planning for engineering initiatives

args.reason: This agent directly orchestrates workforce skill-to-project matching and evaluates capability gaps for engineering changes, making it ideal for analyzing workforce skills and engineering requirements for product line transitions.
